concentration.description: HHI_D = Herfindahl index of designed production shares (allied_network_diagnostics.csv, 22 stages). HHI_N = Herfindahl index of the network nodes' 2024 basket exports (allied_network_observed_hhi.csv: reconciled Comtrade matrix, importer report else exporter mirror x 1.06; shares within the 37 nodes; the EU-27 node counts extra-EU exports only), 18 stages with an HS6 basket. HHI_W = Herfindahl index of 2024 exports of the basket across all reporters of the trade theme (trade_concentration_tbl, variable exports, raw; equal to its stored raw HHI; Hong Kong is not among the exporters, as a re-export hub). network_share_of_world = share of world exports of the 63 network economies ( 57 members + 6 EU members outside the tiers; gross, incl. intra-EU).
concentration.semiconductors_note: trade theme also has Semiconductors Midstream, not a network technology; excluded

design_vs_exporters.description: Per basket stage: share of designed production assigned to nodes outside the three largest exporting nodes (2024 reconciled basket trade, EU counting extra-EU exports, the calibration reference) and the Spearman rank correlation across the 37 nodes between designed production share and observed export share (zeros included).

portfolio.gdp_note: GDP: WDI NY.GDP.MKTP.CD, latest finite year per member; the EU node sums its 27 members

endowment.description: Designed Upstream producers checked against the SI endowment screen (technology-level Reserves or Production > 0; EU node endowed if any member is). Technologies without reserves or production records are not screened.
